hooks.name: TechLead No Source Read
hooks.description: Hard-blocks the TechLead orchestrator from reading src/**/*.cs files. .kiro/**, docs/**, and *.md are allowed.

action.command: pwsh -NoProfile -Command "$json = $input | Out-String | ConvertFrom-Json; $p = $json.tool_input.path; if ($p -match '[/\\]src[/\\].*\.cs$') { [Console]::Error.WriteLine('BLOCKED: TechLead may not read src/**/*.cs. Delegate to a subagent.'); exit 2 }; exit 0"
